up: Retrieve the exact activity values and chemical structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613930. Include the standard value, units, type, relation, and canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613930'
